import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def coin_change_precond (coins : List Nat) (amount : Nat) : Prop :=
  coins.length > 0 ∧
  coins.length ≤ 100 ∧
  amount ≤ 10000 ∧
  ∀ i, i < coins.length → (coins.getD i 0 > 0 ∧ coins.getD i 0 ≤ 10000)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
noncomputable section

def cc_listNatToInt (s : List Nat) : List Int :=
  s.map (fun x => (x : Int))

def cc_total_amount (counts : List Int) (coins : List Int) : Int :=
  (counts.zip coins).foldl (fun acc pair => acc + pair.1 * pair.2) 0

def cc_total_coins (counts : List Int) : Int :=
  counts.foldl (fun acc c => acc + c) 0

def cc_valid_change (counts : List Int) (coins : List Int)
    (amount : Int) : Prop :=
  counts.length = coins.length ∧
  (∀ i, i < counts.length → counts.getD i 0 ≥ 0) ∧
  cc_total_amount counts coins = amount

def cc_solutionAt (coins : List Nat) (amount : Nat) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ counts : List Int,
    cc_valid_change counts (cc_listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) ∧
    cc_total_coins counts = (n : Int)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def coin_change (coins : List Nat) (amount : Nat)
    (h_precond : coin_change_precond coins amount) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  by
    classical
    exact
      if h : ∃ n : Nat, cc_solutionAt coins amount n then
        (Nat.find h : Int)
      else
        -1
  -- !benchmark @end code

/-! ## Postcondition auxiliary definitions -/
def listNatToInt (s : List Nat) : List Int :=
  s.map (fun x => (x : Int))

def total_amount (counts : List Int) (coins : List Int) : Int :=
  (counts.zip coins).foldl (fun acc pair => acc + pair.1 * pair.2) 0

def total_coins (counts : List Int) : Int :=
  counts.foldl (fun acc c => acc + c) 0

def is_valid_change (counts : List Int) (coins : List Int) (amount : Int) : Prop :=
  counts.length = coins.length ∧
  (∀ i, i < counts.length → counts.getD i 0 ≥ 0) ∧
  total_amount counts coins = amount

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def coin_change_postcond (coins : List Nat) (amount : Nat) (result : Int)
    (h_precond : coin_change_precond coins amount) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (result ≠ -1 →
    (∃ counts : List Int,
        is_valid_change counts (listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) ∧
        total_coins counts = result) ∧
    (∀ counts : List Int,
        is_valid_change counts (listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) →
        total_coins counts ≥ result))
  ∧
  (result = -1 →
    ∀ counts : List Int,
      is_valid_change counts (listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) → False)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond


-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma cc_foldl_add_eq_add_sum (xs : List Int) (acc : Int) :
    xs.foldl (fun a x => a + x) acc = acc + xs.sum := by
  induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [ih]
      simp [add_assoc]

lemma cc_total_coins_eq_sum (counts : List Int) :
    cc_total_coins counts = counts.sum := by
  unfold cc_total_coins
  rw [cc_foldl_add_eq_add_sum]
  simp

lemma cc_total_coins_nonneg (counts : List Int)
    (h : ∀ i, i < counts.length → counts.getD i 0 ≥ 0) :
    cc_total_coins counts ≥ 0 := by
  rw [cc_total_coins_eq_sum]
  induction counts with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hx : x ≥ 0 := by
        simpa using h 0 (by simp)
      have hxs : ∀ i, i < xs.length → xs.getD i 0 ≥ 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have hi' : Nat.succ i < (x :: xs).length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons]
          omega
        have hh := h (Nat.succ i) hi'
        simpa using hh
      have hsum : xs.sum ≥ 0 := ih hxs
      simp only [List.sum_cons]
      omega

lemma cc_valid_change_iff (counts : List Int) (coins : List Nat)
    (amount : Nat) :
    cc_valid_change counts (cc_listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) ↔
      is_valid_change counts (listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) := by
  rfl

lemma cc_total_coins_eq (counts : List Int) :
    cc_total_coins counts = total_coins counts := by
  rfl

end
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem coin_change_postcond_satisfied (coins : List Nat) (amount : Nat)
    (h_precond : coin_change_precond coins amount) :
    coin_change_postcond coins amount (coin_change coins amount h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  classical
  unfold coin_change_postcond
  unfold coin_change
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    constructor
    · intro _
      constructor
      · have hs := Nat.find_spec h
        rcases hs with ⟨counts, hvalid, htotal⟩
        refine ⟨counts, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact (cc_valid_change_iff counts coins amount).mp hvalid
        · simpa only [cc_total_coins_eq] using htotal
      · intro counts hvalid
        have hcc :
            cc_valid_change counts (cc_listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) :=
          (cc_valid_change_iff counts coins amount).mpr hvalid
        have hnonneg : cc_total_coins counts ≥ 0 :=
          cc_total_coins_nonneg counts hcc.2.1
        let n : Nat := (cc_total_coins counts).toNat
        have hn : cc_solutionAt coins amount n := by
          refine ⟨counts, hcc, ?_⟩
          dsimp [n]
          exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg).symm
        have hmin : Nat.find h ≤ n :=
          Nat.find_min' h hn
        rw [← cc_total_coins_eq]
        calc
          cc_total_coins counts = (n : Int) := by
            dsimp [n]
            exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg).symm
          _ ≥ (Nat.find h : Int) := by
            exact_mod_cast hmin
    · intro heq
      omega
  case isFalse h =>
    constructor
    · intro hne
      exact False.elim (hne rfl)
    · intro _
      intro counts hvalid
      apply h
      have hcc :
          cc_valid_change counts (cc_listNatToInt coins) (amount : Int) :=
        (cc_valid_change_iff counts coins amount).mpr hvalid
      have hnonneg : cc_total_coins counts ≥ 0 :=
        cc_total_coins_nonneg counts hcc.2.1
      refine ⟨(cc_total_coins counts).toNat, counts, hcc, ?_⟩
      exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg).symm
  -- !benchmark @end proof
